lessons.objective: Hypotheses: si + imparfait: In a hypothesis, put si plus the imparfait in the if-clause and the conditional in the result: si j'avais le temps, je viendrais.

Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. lessons.explanation:
Remove -er; add -e, -es, -e, -ons, -ez, -ent. Use the present for habits and current facts. Je becomes j' before a vowel or a silent h.
parler · je: je parle — to speak · Regular -er present
travailler · je: je travaille — to work · Regular -er present
lessons.speakingPrompt: Use Regular -er present while discussing a late arrival. You and a French-speaking classmate are discussing a late arrival. Remove -er; add -e, -es, -e, -ons, -ez, -ent. Use the present for habits and current facts. Je becomes j' before a vowel or a silent h. Ask for the missing detail, respond to the partner, clarify one misunderstanding, and agree on the next step. Use examples from the reading and your own details. Explain the grammar in English if asked.

items.note: Regular -er present; -e, -es and -ent are silent, so je parle, tu parles and ils parlent sound the same

Remove -re; add -s, -s, nothing, -ons, -ez, -ent. The il form is the bare stem: il vend, il attend.

items.target: Le cours est court ; pourtant, il demande une pratique quotidienne.
items.native: The course is short; however, it requires daily practice.

items.target: Bien que je travaille le matin, je peux suivre le cours l'après-midi.
items.native: Although I work in the morning, I can attend in the afternoon.

items.target: Les classes sont petites, c'est pourquoi tout le monde participe.
items.native: The classes are small, so everyone participates.

items.target: De plus, le centre est près de chez moi.
items.native: Also, the center is near my home.

items.target: Le prix comprend le matériel, mais pas le transport.
items.native: The price includes the materials, but not transportation.

items.target: Pour ces raisons, j'ai décidé de m'inscrire.
items.native: For these reasons, I decided to enroll.

items.target: Mon frère pensait que le cours serait trop intensif.
items.native: My brother thought the course would be too intensive.

items.target: Je lui ai expliqué que je pouvais choisir un groupe du week-end.
items.native: I explained that I could choose a weekend group.
